title: 0x Swap Quote Structure
description: Field-level documentation for the firm quote payload returned by /swap/allowance-holder/quote and /swap/permit2/quote.

fields.name: liquidityAvailable
fields.description: Whether the aggregated liquidity routes can fill the requested pair at the requested size. If false, no other fields are populated.

fields.name: chainId
fields.description: The chain on which the quote was generated. See https://docs.0x.org/introduction/supported-chains.

fields.name: buyToken
fields.description: Contract address of the buy-side token.

fields.name: sellToken
fields.description: Contract address of the sell-side token.

fields.name: buyAmount
fields.description: Quantity of buyToken the taker will receive, expressed in base units.

fields.name: sellAmount
fields.description: Quantity of sellToken the taker spends, in base units.

fields.name: minBuyAmount
fields.description: Minimum acceptable buyAmount after applying slippage tolerance.

fields.name: blockNumber
fields.description: Block number at which the liquidity sources were sampled.

fields.name: allowanceTarget
fields.description: Contract the taker must approve to spend sellToken. Null for native asset trades and wrap/unwrap.

fields.name: transaction
fields.description: Pre-built transaction calldata for direct submission to the network.

fields.name: to
fields.description: Settler contract address.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Encoded swap calldata.

fields.name: gas
fields.description: Gas estimate.

fields.name: gasPrice
fields.description: Suggested gas price in wei.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Native-token value to send (non-zero only when sellToken is the native asset).

fields.name: route
fields.description: Routing detail showing which liquidity sources fill which fraction of the order.

fields.name: fees
fields.description: Breakdown of integrator fee, 0x platform fee, and gas fee.

fields.name: integratorFee
fields.description: Fee accruing to the integrator (configurable via swapFeeBps / swapFeeRecipient).

fields.name: zeroExFee
fields.description: 0x platform fee.

fields.name: gasFee
fields.description: Estimated network gas fee.

fields.name: issues
fields.description: Pre-submission issues: insufficient allowance, insufficient balance, invalid sources, etc.

fields.name: permit2
fields.description: Permit2 EIP-712 typed data the taker must sign. Only present on the Permit2 flow.

fields.name: totalNetworkFee
fields.description: Total network fee in native-token base units.

fields.name: expiration
fields.description: Quote expiry timestamp.
